issue_request: FHIR-50152 is an Applied/Persuasive PA change request asking that VirtualServiceDetail be allowed as a datatype for Extension.value[x], similar to Availability and ExtendedContactDetail.
initial_application: No FHIR-50152-tagged source commit was found in the HL7/fhir checkout. The local source already leaves Extension.value[x] as a wildcard type and lists VirtualServiceDetail as an active metadatatype; Jira's applied comment points to an org.hl7.fhir.core TypesUtilities change that adds VirtualServiceDetail to wildcard metadata type expansion.
additional_context: PA May 2025 WGM minutes record the motion that the datatype would be added for Extension use. A later Zulip thread shows the invalid-constrained-type tooling failure around Appointment.virtualService and Grahame noting he was working on it. The current build's extension.profile.json now includes VirtualServiceDetail in Extension.value[x].
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the authoritative source in this repository is already in build scope and generic, while the concrete missing behavior was corrected in shared FHIR core tooling used to generate the current build.
